stores.title: Tīpakohia ō toa
stores.description: He rerekē ngā utu i ia peka, nō reira tīpakohia tō toa e pai ai. Ko te peka tata ki tō wāhi Home Assistant kei runga rawa o te rārangi — hurihia mēnā ka hoko koe ki wāhi kē. Tīmata ki te tāuru kia rapu.

primary_chain.title: Hokomaha matua
primary_chain.description: Tīpakohia te wāhi e nui ai tō hoko. Ko tōna hītori ōta te mea e tika ai tō rārangi hoko.

error.cannot_connect: Kāore e taea te toro atu ki te tāpiri takiuru. Tirohia kua tāutaina, kei te rere hoki.
